resources.string: 100% on-device · No cloud · No accounts · No ads
Pick languages and caption font below. Start opens model choice, then live captions.
Save subtitles to a text file
When on, each live session writes a .txt file under the app Documents/captions folder on this device. Local only.
Captions float above videos and games. Android needs “display over other apps” so the bubble can stay visible while you watch something else.
Caption Action captions sounds playing on your device (videos, games, media). Android requires this audio permission for screen-audio capture. Audio never leaves your phone.
A quiet notification keeps the live session running in the background.
Android’s screen-capture prompt lets Caption Action hear app playback (YouTube, games, media) — not your microphone as the product. Allow it so captions follow what is playing on screen.
Permissions ready — tap Start live captions again to begin.
Playback capture declined — using microphone instead.
Fast — SenseVoice multilingual (~228 MB) · Real ASR
Balanced — ggml Base (~57 MB) · whisper.cpp ASR
Accurate — ggml Small (~182 MB) · whisper.cpp ASR
Download a model for on-device captions (Fast SenseVoice or Balanced/Accurate whisper.cpp). Models stay on your phone. Interrupted downloads can resume.
A real model is required — download Fast, Balanced, or Accurate to start.
Dual subtitles need a supported target language from the list (offline ML Kit MT).
Permission still needed — try again from the explanation screen.
Not enough storage for the model.
Model missing or incomplete. Download Fast, Balanced, or Accurate to start captions.
Could not capture device playback audio. Allow screen/audio capture and try again.
Could not load on-device ASR. Re-download the selected model or reinstall the app.
Live subtitles overlay active — tap the green dot to end
Partial download found — tap to resume
Pick a font here. Move and resize the box on the live overlay after Start.
Thanks for downloading Caption Action and spending time with it. Hope the captions make your world a little brighter.

Offline MT does not support target %1$s.
Offline translation: Google ML Kit on-device (any tier → Languages list). Packs prepare in the background — Start does not wait on them. Whisper EN translate remains a fast path.
Translation pack issue: %1$s — packs keep preparing in the background. Captions may stay in the spoken language until ready.
Translation pack missing for this language pair. Connect once to download, then retry.
Preparing session — you will get the screen-share prompt next.
